name: Grave Gown (Greater)
text:
Grave gowns look like flowing formalwear used in funeral rites across the Universe. If you die wearing a grave gown, your corpse is affected by a 2nd-rank Peaceful Rest spell.

Activate—In Memoriam f (healing, vitality)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You gain the dying condition

---
Effect The silk threads of the grave gown glow with supernatural power. Allies within a 30-foot emanation regain 4d8 healing Hit Points and gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls for 1 round. You use this reaction before you lose the ability to act.
